app.name: Compliance Engine
screening.passed: Screening passed: the subject is not on sanctions list version {version}.
screening.failed: Screening failed: the subject cannot be proven absent from the sanctions list.
errors.nonmembership.KEY_OUT_OF_DOMAIN: The subject key is outside the valid key range.
errors.nonmembership.KEY_NOT_IN_RANGE: The subject key is not strictly inside the proven range; it may be listed.
errors.nonmembership.BAD_PATH_LENGTH: The Merkle path has the wrong length or index.
errors.nonmembership.ROOT_MISMATCH: The proof does not match the published sanctions list root.
report.accounts.one: {count} account included in the proof of reserves.
report.accounts.other: {count} accounts included in the proof of reserves.
errors.intake.UNSUPPORTED_ALG: The credential uses an unsupported signature or hash algorithm. Only ES256 with SHA-256 is accepted.
errors.intake.UNTRUSTED_ISSUER: The credential issuer is not on the trusted issuer list, or its entry is not valid at this time.
errors.intake.NOT_YET_VALID: The credential is not valid yet.
errors.intake.BAD_VCT: The credential type is not accepted.
errors.intake.DISCLOSURE_INVALID: A disclosed claim is malformed, duplicated or conflicts with another claim.
errors.intake.DISCLOSURE_NOT_REFERENCED: A disclosed claim is not covered by the issuer signature.
errors.intake.MISSING_IDENTIFIER: The identifier needed for screening was not disclosed.
errors.intake.HOLDER_BINDING_REQUIRED: Proof that the holder presented this credential is required.
errors.intake.HOLDER_BINDING_INVALID: The holder binding proof is invalid, stale, or was made for a different request.
